cmp_tool.jpg.title: File:Chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP-108, conditioner).jpg
cmp_tool.jpg.desc: Pad conditioner (Chiaping model 108) for the chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP), which removes material from uneven topography on a wafer surface until a flat surface is created.

euv_tool.jpg.title: File:Extreme ultraviolet lithography tool.jpg
euv_tool.jpg.desc: EUVL tool, that deposits virtually defect-free, ultra-thin films on integrated circuits.

euv_resist_blur.png.title: File:80 eV electron blur in EUV Resist.png
euv_resist_blur.png.desc: The exposure of a leading EUV chemically amplified resist by an 80 eV flood electron beam can lead to resist thickness loss up to ~7.5 nm. The 80 eV represents typical EUV photoelectron energy, so resist dimensions requiring control to within ~15 nm would be affected. Ref.: Y. Kandel et al., Proc. S
